title: Polarization along a list
statement: For every Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, coordinate $i$, and finite list of coordinates $L$, polarizing along the list beginning with $i$ is the same as first polarizing the function at coordinate $i$ and then polarizing along $L$.
hypotheses_covered: The input is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
